evidence: Ellipsometry (MX75/100T) was used to measure the film thickness and the refractive index. The cross-sectional atomic structure of the films was investigated using high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HR-TEM). Surface morphology was examined with atomic force microscopy (AFM). The composition of films was analyzed by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). Grazing incidence X-ray diffractometer (XRD) with Cu K/SLalpha radiation was employed to investigate the crystalline properties of the films. The capacitance–voltage (C –V ) and current–voltage (I–V ) characteristics were studied at high frequency (1 MHz) using a 4284A Precision LCR Meter and E5270A, respectively.
